provider: DataCite Public REST API (metadata) for 4TU.ResearchData STORM IBTrACS v4
api_version: DataCite Public REST API v2; singleton DOI 10.4121/12706085.v4

request_contract.parameter_rules: Exactly one opt-in, anonymous, repository-constructed GET for the fixed DOI 10.4121/12706085.v4 (no query parameters, redirects, pagination, retries, caller-supplied URLs, headers, tokens or alternative DOIs). DataCite publicly documents this singleton metadata API. Only public DataCite DOI JSON metadata may be read and SHA-receipted transiently. No 4TU/STORM track files, asset URLs, enumeration, polling or dataset bytes are authorized. A response identity/licence mismatch must fail closed.

response_contract.format: DataCite public singleton DOI JSON:API metadata response (data.type=dois, exact data.id and attributes.doi).
response_contract.scientific_semantics: This DOI identifies STORM IBTrACS present-climate v4, a 10,000-synthetic-year tropical-cyclone track catalogue. Version v4 corrects past track-duplication and storm-category mistakes. A DataCite JSON record neither enumerates exact downloadable v4 files nor verifies their native schema, units, storm/year identity or hashes. Synthetic tracks are not observed storm records; tracks alone are not spatial wind/surge footprints or insured losses.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: DataCite documents unrestricted anonymous public DOI metadata retrieval and rate limits; this contract is intentionally much narrower: one manual, fixed DOI GET per --probe-once, 20-second timeout, 256-KiB cap, no redirects, no retries, no recurring polling, no broad harvest. DataCite recommends identifiable User-Agent for frequent scripted calls; this runner does not make frequent requests. Never escalate automatically to dataset assets.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: DOI v4 is version-pinned but the public metadata record is mutable: original capture 2026-11-03, 14,825 bytes, SHA-256 90bbb620c7e04632e45b5c86c2998b3b023a55d246b56c2c7f09cc1a66c62f66, with provider reported metadata updated 2025-06-01T05:36:28Z. Any subsequent response must produce a new bounded original byte digest; a differing digest is not by itself evidence that STORM v4 track bytes changed. Track file inventory, sizes, checksums, native schema and year/event semantics remain separately unverified.

rights_and_policy.notes: DataCite official public REST API guidance explicitly invites anonymous DOI metadata retrieval/harvesting, and the DataCite Data File Use Policy states its deposited bibliographic metadata are CC0 and available for any purpose. This source-specific judgement permits only one narrow public metadata GET; it is not general website scraping. General website Terms restrict systematic website scraping, which this fixed API canary does not perform. This metadata scope does not transfer CC0 to linked provider datasets, files, names/logos, sensitive elements or STORM track assets; separate 4TU source rights and exact-file admission remain necessary.

expected_evidence: one exact public GET URL and response HTTP 200 with no redirect
response application/json or application/vnd.api+json and at most 262144 bytes
same-body response SHA-256, retrieval UTC and source access_id
strict exact v4 DOI, dataset title, version, types and licence conflict gate
no provider response body or data files persisted
metadata-only receipt with source_admission_extended=false and model_input_approved=false

notes: T1: one manual opt-in DataCite DOI metadata GET through research_runners/storm_v4_datacite_probe_v0.py with fail-closed exact contract and offline synthetic tests. No provider request has yet been successfully executed or receipted in this PR; probe_ready means executable contract, not verified live access. STORM track assets and actual CAT model data remain outside scope, unacquired and unapproved.
